defaults.backend: complete: clean-room sales engagement governance with a governed 29-signal catalog (26 free, 3 explicitly confirmed paid), cohort builder over persisted workspace leads, deterministic local offer suggestion and sequence drafting, a durable local outbox with an approval/pause/dry-run/cancel status ladder, opt-in autopilot with approval default, global and per-inbox pauses, and local send-rule/header extension points
defaults.frontend: complete: dedicated sales-engagement Operations route renders the signal catalog with confirmed activation, cohorts with evaluation, offers and sequence drafts, sending mode/autopilot/pause governance, send rules and the outbox ladder; static guard in test_ui_wiring.py
defaults.database: complete: eight additive workspace-scoped tables created by migration b7c9d0e1f2a3 (signal_codes, sales_cohorts, sales_outreach_drafts, offer_suggestions, outbox_messages, sending_configs, inbox_pauses, send_rules); unique constraints prevent duplicate codes/cohorts/rules and per-workspace sending configs; the pre-existing CRM outreach_drafts table is untouched
defaults.api: complete: one stable sales-engagement API group (version 1, no legacy claim, external_calls=false, external_delivery=false) covering signals, cohorts, offers, drafts, sending status/mode, autopilot opt-in, pauses, send rules and the outbox ladder
defaults.permissions: complete: verify_workspace plus require(CONTACT_READ) for reads and require(NOTE_WRITE) for all engagement mutations; paid signal activation and autopilot opt-in require explicit confirmation; cross-workspace entity access fails closed with 404 and all mutations are audited
defaults.integration: complete: cohort evaluation reads NOVARA's existing leads model; outbox drafts reference the module's own sales_outreach_drafts; no Sellbird source, broker, outbound email, paid signal vendor or external AI provider is contacted or copied
defaults.criteria: Twelve named acceptance tests plus a workspace-isolation test prove the governed signal catalog, confirmed free/paid activation, cohort evaluation over real leads, local drafting and offers, the durable outbox status ladder, opt-in autopilot, pause controls, send-rule/header extensions, sending mode validation and a wired UI route.
defaults.remaining: No remaining work for the recorded local acceptance criteria. Sellbird-hosted discovery cost estimation, MCP tools, CLI, broker delivery, real email sending and paid signal data vendors remain out of scope and are not claimed.
